g.text: Weighting and RNA-only QC sensitivity of the same eight targets
All-source RNA denominators in every case. Equal = mean barcode CPM, then log2(mean CPM + 1).
RNA QC: 200–2500 detected genes, RNA counts ≥500, mt- fraction ≤0.40; this omits the author’s ATAC QC.
Same deposited libraries and reused CTRL; these cases are sensitivity checks, not independent replications.
